android.desc: Stop drowning in browser tabs. Start mastering the threat landscape. Information overload is a security risk. Cyber Pulse is an agentic threat intelligence app designed to aggregate chaotic global sources and distill them into actionable, high-signal intelligence in seconds. Built specifically for security professionals, Cyber Pulse eliminates dashboard fatigue. Our engine doesn’t just aggregate RSS feeds—it correlates multiple reports, extracts technical entities, and maps active campaigns. 🛡️ Core Capabilities Unified Morning Briefing: A highly curated, data-dense executive summary of the last 24 hours of global threat activity, delivered before your first coffee. Agentic Deep-Dive Analysis: Go beyond the headline. Get immediate inline visibility into CVE identifiers, EPSS exploit probability scores, CISA KEV listings, public PoC availability, and vendor mitigation strategies. Zero-Noise Deduplication: Our pipeline filters out marketing fluff, repetitive vendor press releases, and duplicate reporting, leaving you with a pure, high-signal InfoSec telemetry feed. Verified Sources Only: Maintain total transparency and trust with direct outbound links to the original investigative reports and NVD databases for every analysis. Effortless Thought Leadership (Pro): Don’t just read the news—command it. One click transforms complex technical threat summaries into perfectly structured, executive-grade social media updates for LinkedIn and X. Adaptive Voice Modeling (Pro): Our advanced pipeline completely avoids robotic AI clichés. The social drafting engine implicitly monitors your text edits, learning your specific professional tone over time so every post sounds authentically like you. Hardened Verification Loops: To mitigate the risk of AI hallucinations and technical inaccuracies, every generated brief passes through an adversarial secondary validation agent. ⚡ Choose Your Tier Free Plan: Complete access to the AI-powered morning briefing. Clean, filtered daily security news feed. Direct email forwarding for seamless team sharing. Pro Tier (Premium Subscriptions via Google Play): The Thought Leader Package: Instantly generate professional, technical threat advisories with an engine that autonomously learns your writing style and professional tone with every edit. show_hn.title: Show HN: Cyber Pulse. AI pipeline for triage and alerting on cyber news/intel

quotes.text:
I work in cyber security and built this android app to help me keep up to date with the latest news stories and summarise the most important information. It provides two executive summaries per day and alerts for critical news throughout.

I’m using Gemini Pro 3 to analyse recent articles from a list of trusted sources. It identifies the 5 highest priority stories, considering things like if a vulnerability is being actively exploited, novelty and breadth.

If CVEs are identified, it will check for CISA KEV status, EPSS score and if POCs are available on GitHub. It then provides an overall executive summary plus analysis for the top stories, including details, affected systems, potential impact and mitigation actions.

The brief is then passed to Gemini again for verification and fact checking against the source articles and other CVE data retrieved to correct any potential hallucinations.

It’s a paid monthly subscription based app, but it has a 7 day free trial for new users. You can manage subscriptions and cancel from the account tab. If anyone wants an extension I can look at setting up a promo code, please message me.

I would be very grateful for feedback, particularly if the mitigation information is useful, if you think the critical alerts are critical enough to be notified about, any good sources I could add or anything else.

Happy to answer questions. 
Play Store Link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cyberpulse.cyber_pulse
